name: deed-page
description: Publish files to a public deed.page URL only when the user asks to publish, deploy, host, or share a link. Create-only stays local. No account.

interface.longDescription: Publish an HTML file or a static folder to a public https://<slug>.deed.page/ URL when the user asks to publish, deploy, host, or share a link. Create-only requests stay a local draft until they confirm. No account, API key, or email code. Bundles the deed-page skill and the deed.page MCP server.
defaultPrompt: Publish this folder to deed.page and give me the link
